title: Screenwriter Sō Kuramoto dies at 91, author of 'Kita no Kuni Kara'
summary: The renowned Japanese screenwriter, creator of iconic dramas such as 'Kita no Kuni Kara' and 'Yasuragi no Sato', died at 91, prompting condolences in the entertainment world.

title: Former Yokohama Mayor Yamanaka announces candidacy after resigning over workplace harassment
summary: Takeharu Yamanaka, who resigned as Yokohama mayor over a power harassment scandal, is running again in the special election.

title: Five men arrested near British air base used by U.S. to attack Iran
summary: British police arrested five people suspected of preparing terrorist acts near the RAF base used by U.S. forces in the attack on Iran.

title: Japan's corporate service prices rise 3.7% in August, largest increase in decades
summary: The corporate service price index rose 3.7% year-on-year in August, driven by Middle East uncertainty, according to the Bank of Japan.

title: Japanese Defense Ministry launches new system to incorporate startup technology into military equipment
summary: A procurement method is introduced that facilitates participation of startups in defense equipment development, with a public call for proposals planned.

title: Man found stabbed to death in Yokohama apartment after argument
summary: Police investigate the murder of a man in a Yokohama apartment building, where witnesses reported a heated argument and throat-slitting gestures.

title: Ōnosato secures first victory in a year and celebrates comeback at press conference
summary: Sumo wrestler Ōnosato ended a year-long winless streak and expressed relief after overcoming a difficult period.

title: Woman dies in landslide caused by Typhoon 25, husband recounts anguish
summary: A week after Typhoon 25 passed, the death of a woman swept away by a mudslide is confirmed; her husband had held out hope of finding her alive.
